explanation: Dice, Pawn, Card, and Spinner are all active components that are manipulated, moved, or used to determine actions and outcomes within a game. The Board is the static playing surface upon which the game is played, rather than an interactive piece itself.
The first four are renowned natural wonders of the world, while Machu Picchu is a historical man-made citadel.
All items except 'Glass' represent abstract concepts, states, or agreements that can be 'broken' in an idiomatic or non-physical sense. 'Glass' is a physical object that undergoes physical breakage.
